description: Definitions shared by the sh.unset.block types, wherever a block is shown.

image.description: An image stored as a blob in the repository of the record that holds the block, with its alt text and proportions.
The image file. Readers never hand it to a browser without checking its type and re-encoding it; the declared type may be wrong.

alt.description: Alt text for people who cannot see the image. An empty string means the image is decorative.

aspectRatio.description: The image's proportions, so a reader can reserve its space before it loads.

caption.description: Text shown under the image, where the reader shows one.

aspectRatio.description: Width to height. It may be approximate. Readers clamp extreme proportions. Same shape as app.bsky.embed.defs#aspectRatio.
